entries.claim: The pinned Mass proper and Horae common references resolve to the complete 80-word Mass Advent reading. The three exact original files and both reference edges are bound in the declared raw reading; this is a derived comparison, not independent textual ancestry.

The Benziger 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page prints the complete 80-word Epistle body, including its liturgical opening, without an abbreviated conclusion or expansion. The heading and Isaias 7:10–15 reference are framing, not words of this child text.
